# Garhoud Substation

> This package comprises three grid substations in Dubai, sited at Al Garhoud, the Factories area and along Emirates Road. Each houses switchgear and transformers that step transmission-level supply down for distribution to the commercial, industrial and residential districts around it. Buildings of this kind are secure and largely unattended, with dedicated cooling, fire protection and monitoring, and they sit at the heart of an electricity network that has expanded steadily with the city.

## Project Overview

- Category: Infrastructure & Utilities
- Location: Dubai, UAE
- Status: Completed

## MENASCO Scope

DEWA contract CE/448C/2007 covered three electrical substations in Dubai, at Al Garhoud, the Factories area and Emirates Road. MENASCO executed the MEP works across all three sites directly for the Dubai Electricity and Water Authority, which also acted as consultant. The package forms part of MENASCO's portfolio of DEWA substation projects supporting the growth of the emirate's power network.
